theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_st_interior_product
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (τ : Fin (m + 1) → Eucl P) (g : Eucl P) (w : NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)), Orthonormal ℝ τ → g ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (range τ) → g ≠ 0 → (w = simpleNVector τ ∨ w = -simpleNVector τ) → ∃ τ' : Fin m → Eucl P, Orthonormal ℝ τ' ∧ Submodule.span ℝ (range τ') = Submodule.span ℝ (range τ) ⊓ (ℝ ∙ g)ᗮ ∧ (w.comp ((ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFinCLM ℝ (Eucl P) ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℝ (Eucl P) (Covector (Eucl P) m) (innerSL ℝ (‖g‖⁻¹ • g)))) = simpleNVector τ' ∨ w.comp ((ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFinCLM ℝ (Eucl P) ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℝ (Eucl P) (Covector (Eucl P) m) (innerSL ℝ (‖g‖⁻¹ • g)))) = -simpleNVector τ')
